name: Kungsbacka C - Tjolöholm
description: Kungsbacka C to Tjolöholm. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Toalett och dricksvatten Kungsbacka: Official toilet and drinking water at Kungsbacka torg. Official text says open year-round.
notes: Official page/API display 22 km and API length_in_meters is 22000, while GPX desc says Total: 22.2 km and computed official GPX/API geometry is 22.140 km.
Hallandsleden section-specific API geo_json exactly matches official GPX, but line.geometry is missing. Trail overview pass also recorded sparse/empty Kusten linework.

Official Hallandsleden, Länsstyrelsen, Tjolöholm and Naturkartan text confirm shelter/fireplace context, but no exact shelter/fireplace coordinate was found. OSM has Kvarndammet lake relation center, not facility point.
Tjolöholm official page says camping is prohibited all over Tjolöholm, but also has paid quickstop motorhome spaces at the parking area.
Official K2 difficulty is Grön/easy. Some Tjolöholm local-loop AllTrails reports describe moderate/steep/rocky sections, but those are partial local trails and not the whole K2.
Official places API includes Fjärås services about 2.7 km off-route and Onsala lodging about 4 km off-route.
